name: Zipz (Garden City, UT) Western BBQ Bacon Cheeseburger (Hold Raw Onion)
whyItWorks: Smoky bacon, melted cheddar cheese, and sweet barbecue sauce on a charbroiled beef patty. Holding raw onions keeps it digestible in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Western BBQ Burger with light BBQ sauce and request no raw onion rings.
